title: Benchmarking Language Models for Statistical Problem Formulation
abstract: arXiv:2609.01982v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as assistants for statistical and data science work, yet existing evaluations largely assume the analysis target is already specified. In practice, users arrive with informal goals and heterogeneous data, leaving the model to decide what statistical task is implied and which data are relevant. We first formalize this upstream step as Statistical Problem Formulation and decompose it into two subtasks: (1) Statistical Problem Classification and (2) Variable Identification & Role Assignment. We then introduce StatFormBench, a benchmark built from five cross-domain statistics textbooks and a data science case library, covering diverse problem types, data representations, and scenario styles. It contains 1,013 samples spanning 20 coarse-grained and 85 fine-grained statistical problem categories. translated_title: 统计问题构建的语言模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作统计和数据科学工作的助手，然而现有的评估大多假设分析目标已经被明确指定。在实际应用中，用户往往带着非正式的目标和异构的数据前来，需要模型自行判断其中隐含的统计任务是什么以及哪些数据是相关的。我们首先将这一上游步骤形式化为“统计问题构建”，并将其分解为两个子任务：（1）统计问题分类和（2）变量识别与角色分配。随后我们提出了StatFormBench，这是一个基于五本跨领域统计学教科书和一个数据科学案例库构建的基准测试，涵盖多种问题类型、数据表示形式和场景风格，包含1,013个样本，覆盖20个粗粒度和85个细粒度的统计问题类别。在对14个开源与闭源大语言模型的评估中，表现最好的零样本模型在细粒度分类上也仅达到72.0的成绩（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文首次将“统计问题构建”形式化为大语言模型的上游任务，并构建了涵盖1013个样本、85个细粒度类别的基准StatFormBench，评估显示现有大语言模型在将用户非正式目标转化为明确统计任务方面表现仍然有限。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes Statistical Problem Formulation as an upstream LLM task and introduces StatFormBench, a 1,013-sample benchmark with 85 fine-grained categories, revealing that current LLMs still struggle to translate informal user goals into well-defined statistical tasks.
